'''Henry Dunn''' (forum handle '''WampaX''')<ref name="enc2008">[https://web.archive.org/web/20080803132637/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Encyclopedia Encyclopedia: Volunteer Information], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 3 August 2008)</ref> served as [[Tournament Advocate]] of the [[Players Committee]].

The Encyclopedia's Volunteer Information of 3 August 2008 lists him as Tournament Advocate.<ref name="enc2008" /> A forum post of November 2014 listing past advocates also names Henry Dunn &ldquo;wampax&rdquo; as a Tournament Advocate.<ref name="countdown2014">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=921494#p921494 Countdown: The 20 most influential volunteers in the PC era], post by AnakinSolo (23 November 2014), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums; lists Rustan Sharer &ldquo;rogue4&rdquo; (Communications Advocate) and Mark Peterson &ldquo;lukesbionichand&rdquo; (Rules Advocate)</ref>

== 2007 World Championship ==
Dunn became [[Tournament Advocate]] in February 2007. His duties included overseeing tournament formats, maintaining the official tournament document, and projects for online tournament registration and results entry.<ref name="dunn">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LpWqJgmgh2Q&t=10s Worlds 2007 H Dunn Interview], Star Wars CCG, YouTube (uploaded 7 April 2026), at 00:10. Transcript: [[2007 World Championship interviews (transcript)]].</ref> He was the only Players Committee member present at the [[2007 World Championship]], where he ran the event by hand without tournament software, with help on scoring from a player named Nate and on rules from David Kuhn. He also said that turnout beat his expectation of a low-to-mid-30s day-two field.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LpWqJgmgh2Q&t=595s Worlds 2007 H Dunn Interview], Star Wars CCG, YouTube (uploaded 7 April 2026), at 09:55. Transcript: [[2007 World Championship interviews (transcript)]].</ref> He was from Atlanta, and had started playing with [[Premiere Limited|Premiere]].<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LpWqJgmgh2Q&t=370s Worlds 2007 H Dunn Interview], Star Wars CCG, YouTube (uploaded 7 April 2026), at 06:10. Transcript: [[2007 World Championship interviews (transcript)]].</ref>
